opportunity.title: Joint roster commitments that make a care cohort fundable
opportunity.thesis: Consenting roster changes across employers can concentrate fragmented care demand into a funded qualified opening. A coupled commitment instrument preserves production, individual choices and finite fallback obligations. Existing flexible-care and consortium services are strong prior art; the contribution is a tested bounded construction, not a claim of historical firstness.
opportunity.goal: Construct and independently check a consenting, funded roster-and-care arrangement.
opportunity.successMetric: A fresh synthetic case gains a funded accepted arrangement while staffing, full care, qualifications, consent and finite fallback remain intact; conventional parity and failures stay visible.

sources.title: Boston Fed: nontraditional-hours child care
sources.excerpt: Source synthesis: uncertain timing and composition of nontraditional-hours demand complicate sustainable supply; affordability and qualified staffing also remain constraints. This is context, not a measured customer pipeline.

sources.title: WorkFamily Solutions FAQ — strong prior art
sources.excerpt: Source synthesis: employers can reserve places that accommodate changing shifts and share places among children during regular weekday hours. The retrieved FAQ does not document joint revision of multiple employers production rosters; customized equivalent offerings remain possible.

sources.title: Illinois Action for Children nontraditional-hours research
sources.excerpt: Source synthesis: provider research examines nontraditional-hours care and related scheduling and staffing practices. This study does not transfer Illinois costs, regulation or observed take-up to Montreal.

sources.title: Employer child-care cooperative models
sources.excerpt: Source synthesis: employers can jointly support childcare and contract with an existing provider. The organizational form is prior art; this research tests an explicit finite joint commitment package.

witness.original_useful_purpose: Parents receive complete care coverage for permitted work shifts while employers receive their required staffing and providers receive sufficient funded qualified capacity.
witness.binding_restriction: Fixed work rosters split demand across costly care blocks; no single employer controls the other employer or the provider opening decision.
witness.transformation: Jointly choose only individually permitted roster alternatives and issue conditional payer-backed opening, standby and reserve commitments before the day begins.
preserved_obligations: Employer shift quotas and working hours
Worker permitted options and required change compensation
Every child full interval including location-specific commute
Declared qualified staff, capacity, acceptable sites and staff time limits
Each payer ceiling and category restrictions
Explicit finite pre-start outage worlds, backup and refund accounting
witness.acceptance: Independent recomputation of the complete plan; no contract activation before every distinct responsible party grants consent and funds its obligation.
falsifiers: No accepted plan after preserving all obligations
Existing fixed-roster alternative reaches same outcome at same full funding
Ordinary coordinated implementation already delivers equivalent value at comparable cost
Willingness to pay or permissions fail in actual intake

rights.synthetic_cases: Researcher-created synthetic data; no children or workers identified
rights.sources: Links and limited paraphrases; no license to redistribute full source pages implied
rights.authority: Local research only. Separate employer, worker/parent and provider grants required per mission. No live ENS, wallet, funding, licensing approval or child-care authorization.
rights.sharing: Only qualified public executable structure and synthetic evidence are eligible; no customer records, secrets or protected answers.

uncertainties: Source-linked assessment intervals are subjective ranking signals, not probabilities.
Market novelty and incumbent custom contracting remain unresolved.
Demand, paid API access, actual model token costs and buyer willingness are unobserved.
Synthetic staff qualification flags are declarations, not live license verification.
No physical childcare or legal approval has been supplied.
Construction feasibility does not prove Operational Alpha or net retained Alpha.

next_experiment.smallest_field_step: Request, only after explicit future authorization, an anonymized real option sheet from two employers and written provider availability/cost and incumbent quote; apply unchanged verifier before any commitment.
next_experiment.current_authority: No outreach authorized in this research edition.

milestones.goal: Construct and freeze a finite roster-care instrument.
milestones.successMetric: Origin and adverse constraints are represented with complete state-contingent obligations.
milestones.acceptance: A complete reproducible origin result and a timestamped source/configuration freeze exist; help output alone is not acceptance.
milestones.falsifier: Only a renamed scheduler exists or useful obligations are relaxed.

milestones.goal: Confirm construction and conventional parity on fresh cases.
milestones.successMetric: All frozen fresh worlds retained; independent verifier checks accepted plans and adverse refusals.
milestones.acceptance: Fresh-case outputs and independent audit are inspectable; no protected outcomes in training.
milestones.falsifier: Accepted output violates consent, care, staffing, funding or finite backup.

milestones.goal: Evaluate complete service economics under frozen policies.
milestones.successMetric: Human development, buyer value, price, provider cash and pass-through obligations are separated.
milestones.acceptance: Frozen policy and every fresh modeled world retained, with downside sensitivities and actual receipts zero.
milestones.falsifier: Profit requires unpriced obligations, unchanged demand at higher prices or invented human selling prices.

milestones.goal: Package qualified research artifacts for ordinary publication review.
milestones.successMetric: Readable paper, PDF, complete code/evidence and verified immutable links exist.
milestones.acceptance: Artifact hashes and supported checks pass; canonical deployment and commercial permissions remain separate.
milestones.falsifier: Provenance is presented as truth, simulated receipts as earned revenue, or research artifacts as live authorized ventures.
